name: Tractor & Equipment Co
old_description: Tractor & Equipment Co. offers a wide range of heavy equipment and parts in Great Falls, Montana. You can rely on us when you need dependable machinery to enhance your productivity and efficiency. Whether you’re looking to buy or rent, our team will help you find the perfect equipment, parts or attachments for your applications.
about:
Tractor & Equipment Co. operates from Great Falls, Montana, where it serves as a Caterpillar dealer for heavy equipment, parts, and service. The company's Great Falls location North provides sales, rental, and support for Cat machinery and other brands.

The business stocks a large volume of new, used, and remanufactured parts, filling most orders within 24 hours. Its hydraulics shop rebuilds cylinders, pumps, and motors to like-new condition and fabricates custom hose assemblies. The facility also inspects all used components before sale and sources non-Cat parts on request.

Customers needing heavy equipment rely on the dealer for new and used Cat machines, financing options, and a Cat Commercial Account program with exclusive promotions. The service team maintains both Cat and other popular equipment brands.

The company emphasizes reliability, current technology, and strong resale value on its equipment, while offering financing to ease acquisition. Its parts availability and 24-hour order fulfillment are positioned as key advantages for minimizing downtime.

name: Tradepak Inc
old_description: At Tradepak Inc., we offer cutting-edge flexible packaging solutions for the food industry. We emphasize quality, efficiency, and sustainability.
about:
Tradepak Inc. was founded in 2003 in Miami, Florida, and operates a production plant in South Florida. The company describes itself as a North American flexible packaging manufacturer with permanent commercial representation in the Caribbean and Central America.

The company manufactures a range of flexible packaging products for the food industry, including vacuum pouches, shrink bags, stand-up bags, polyethylene, polypropylene, and polyester films, monolayer and multilayer films, rollstock films, and technical laminates. Its in-house processes cover 8-color flexographic printing, precision slitting, lamination, laser perforation and scoring, and packaging consulting. All conversion takes place in its Miami facility under FDA standards.

Tradepak serves multiple segments of the food industry—poultry, beef, seafood, produce, pet food, frozen food, cereals and bakery, and dairy—supplying both large corporations and small businesses. A testimonial also references a project for an apparel brand, indicating occasional work outside food packaging.

The company highlights its strategic location minutes from Miami International Airport for rapid distribution across the Americas, a bilingual sales team, SQF certification from NSF, and a sustainability focus that includes eco-friendly practices. It also emphasizes over 20 years of experience and consulting expertise spanning 30 years of market knowledge.

name: Traditions in Woodworking
old_description: , we can design and build virtually anything you can imagine in wood. Whether you’re upgrading your space with custom kitchen cabinets as part of a kitchen remodel or enhancing your home with elegant built-ins, our craftsmen are committed to delivering
about:
Traditions in Woodworking operates from Columbia, Missouri, where Christian Heston founded the cabinet shop in 1995 at age 22 after purchasing a building to create lasting, everyday wood products. The company remains under his leadership, emphasizing hard work and fair pricing.

The shop designs, builds, and installs custom cabinets and furniture for kitchens, bathrooms, offices, and entertainment spaces, using traditional joinery, 3/4-inch plywood cases, and hand-selected lumber with coordinated grain patterns. It also produces handcrafted wooden toys for families and Waldorf or Montessori schools, supplies hardwood flooring sourced from domestic mills, and builds custom beekeeping equipment such as swarm traps. Consulting services and custom parts are offered alongside connections to architectural glass and hardware systems.

Customers range from homeowners planning remodels to commercial offices, educational institutions seeking natural toys, and beekeepers. The company has served the Columbia community for over twenty-five years, providing complimentary bids and guiding clients from design through installation.

Heston started the business to build durable, American-made products at a fair price. The firm highlights its use of domestically produced plywood, lifetime-guaranteed hardware, and approved forestry practices, and it offers woodworking classes to share craftsmanship skills.

name: Trailblazer Foods
about:
Trailblazer Foods operates from a facility at 17900 NE San Rafael in Portland, Oregon. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It began as a food manufacturing operation focused on contract production and private-label services for brands and retailers.

The company produces a wide range of shelf-stable food items including preserves, jellies, syrups, toppings, fillings, marinades, jams, and spreads. Its state-of-the-art plant runs at more than 115 tons per day, with daily output exceeding 65 tons of preserves and jellies, 75 tons of syrups, 15 tons of sweetened or unsweetened coconut, 8 tons of pie filling, and 25 tons of sauces and marinades. Co-packing runs start at a minimum of 10,000 pounds (5,000 pounds per batch). An electronic recipe system integrates with scheduling and inventory management to maintain consistency and cost efficiency.

Trailblazer serves food-service establishments, local and national retailers, and brands seeking a contract manufacturing partner. The facility handles an extensive recipe library and is set up for both branded and private-label production runs.

The company emphasizes quality assurance through SQF, GMP, and HACCP certifications, organic certification by Oregon Tilth, and kosher certification by KOF-K. An in-house microbiology lab, third-party audits by Steritech, and a suite of food-safety programs (allergen control, recall drills, glass-breakage policy) support its quality claims.

name: Trexon - EZ Form Cable Corporation
old_description: We are thrilled to announce that EZ Form Cable is celebrating 40 amazing years in business!
about:
EZ Form Cable, an Amphenol company, has operated from Hamden, Connecticut since 1984. The business began as a specialist in coaxial transmission lines and has grown into a certified manufacturer of coaxial cables, cable assemblies, RF connectors, and coaxial delay lines.

The company produces a range of semi-rigid, flexible, and hand-formable coaxial cables, including 27 variants qualified to MIL-DTL-17. Its core competencies cover special impedance cables, low-attenuation assemblies, phase-matched sets, custom delay lines, and a line of stainless-steel and non-magnetic connectors. Production capabilities extend to build-to-print cable assemblies, coaxial baluns, and stripped-and-formed semi-rigid cables.

EZ Form serves military and aerospace programs, cryogenic and quantum computing research, telecommunications infrastructure, medical devices, instrumentation, and test laboratories. Its MIL-DTL-17 QPL products and phase-stable cables are used in applications where signal integrity at microwave and millimeter-wave frequencies is critical.

The company emphasizes a value proposition of quality product, right price, and on-time delivery, backed by a Quick Reaction Capability (QRC) program for rapid turnaround. It cites problem-solving connector designs, uniquely configured delay lines, and lead times described as the shortest in the industry as key differentiators.

name: Triad Electronic Technologies
old_description: Triad is known for extensive printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), final electromechanical systems integration, test services, design for manufacturability feedback, and more.
about:
Triad Electronic Technologies is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. The company was founded in 1998 and later acquired by Jeffries Tooley, LLC, which has continued to expand its expertise and certifications. No individual founders are named in the company's public history.

Triad provides printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), final electromechanical systems integration, test services, and design-for-manufacturability feedback. Its quality-focused processes include new production introduction (NPI), stencil aperture optimization, custom substrate profiling, statistical process control, automated optical inspection with 1 µm accuracy, X-ray inspection at 200x magnification, void measurement, automatic BGA analysis, first-article inspection, and a paperless shop floor with full traceability.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as aerospace, evidenced by a long-term partnership with AmSafe, whose director of supply chain describes Triad as an extension of their own manufacturing capability. The testimonial highlights collaboration on product development, sourcing, manufacturing, and testing over more than ten years.

Triad emphasizes flexibility, responsiveness, and reliability as core values, positioning itself as a true partner through supply-chain excellence, manufacturing efficiency, and a quality policy that targets on-time delivery, continuous improvement, and a staff committed to quality and service.

about:
Triangle Sheetmetal operates from Peoria, Arizona, as a family-owned custom sheet metal fabrication shop. The company has served the commercial HVAC and construction sectors for more than four decades, though a specific founding year is not published.

The shop runs a complete fabrication line that includes roll forming equipment, a full-size coil line, two plasma tables, 10- and 12-foot shears, 10- and 12-foot Cincinnati ProForm+ press brakes, and a full welding department. It produces HVAC rectangular ductwork and fittings, spiral duct and fittings from 3 to 50 inches, grease duct, expansion joints, pipe shields, angles, channels, flashing, corner guards, stair treads, kick plates, pans, roof vents, clips, brackets, gutters, cabinets, panels, scuppers, equipment guards, china caps, collector heads, downspouts, and a range of stocked items such as curb flashing, hanger strap, and channel, along with custom specialty products.

Customers span commercial HVAC and construction projects across Arizona, with documented work for Ak-Chin Casino, Tesla, SRP Valleywide, University of Arizona, Amazon, Top Golf, Intel, TSMC, Microsoft, QTS, Arizona State University, GoDaddy, the Indians Spring Training Stadium, Scottsdale Airport Hangar, Vee Quiva Casino, Dick's Sporting Goods, State Farm Stadium, Fry's grocery stores, Mayo Clinic, Banner Health, hotels, restaurants, schools, and data-center projects.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround, adherence to SMACNA standards, and statewide delivery capability as core differentiators.

name: Trinity Solar
old_description: Take control of your electric bills with one of the best solar installers in NJ
about:
Trinity Solar, based in Wall Township, New Jersey, was founded in 2012 according to company records. The firm states it has over 30 years of experience providing custom solar and roofing solutions, though no individual founders are named in public materials.

The company specializes in residential solar panel installation, battery storage systems, and roofing services across New Jersey, Connecticut, and Delaware. Its process covers free in-home consultation, custom system design, permitting with local utilities and HOAs, and installation completed in one to three days by certified crews. Trinity reports more than 125,000 installations to date and has been ranked a Top Solar Contractor 12 times since 2012.

Trinity serves homeowners seeking to reduce electric bills and gain energy independence. Its customer base spans the Jersey Shore to Trenton, plus regions in Connecticut and Delaware. The company helps clients navigate state incentive programs such as New Jersey’s Successor Solar Incentive (SuSI), property and sales tax exemptions, and net metering.

Trinity emphasizes local relationships with utilities and regulators to accelerate permitting, advocates for policy changes benefiting solar adoption, and supports community organizations including the New Jersey Police Benevolent Association and Jersey Shore Boy Scouts Council. It offers a 25-year parts and labor guarantee and flexible financing with $0 down options.
